text: Reading Passage 3 has seven paragraphs, A-G.
Choose the most suitable headings for paragraphs C-G from the list of headings below.

list: The Crick and Watson approach to research
Anticipating results before data is collected
How research is done and how it is reported
The role of hypotheses in scientific research
Karl Popper's claim that the scientific method is hypothetico-deductive

body.title: In which TWO paragraphs in Reading Passage 3 does the writer give advice directly to the reader?

items: Popper says that the scientific method is hypothetico-deductive.
If a prediction based on a hypothesis is fulfilled, then the hypothesis is confirmed as true.
Many people carry out research in a mistaken way.
The 'scientific method' is more a way of describing research than a way of doing it.

items.title: Which of the following statements best describes the writer's main purpose in Reading Passage 3?
options: to advise Ph.D. students not to cheat while carrying out research
to encourage Ph.D. studentsto work by guesswork and inspiration
to explain to Ph.D. studentsthe logic which the scientific research paper follows
to help Ph.D. students by explaining different conceptions of the research process
